extracted.intended_audience: IMLS staff, museum professionals, grant program evaluators, and evaluation researchers
extracted.subtask_description: Extract and report descriptive statistics (counts and percentages) of IMLS-funded museum projects by primary activity area, secondary activities, partners, audiences served, museum size, and award amount. The page contains tables summarizing project characteristics across these dimensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number and Percent of Projects with Technology as Primary Focus by Other Activities Conducted (Table III-14e)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-14 e: Number and Percent of Projects with Technology as the Primary Focus by Other Activities Conducted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-tabulation of projects whose primary focus is Technology/Online Resources by whether they also conducted specific other activities (e.g., inventory collections, move collections, create public collections finding guides, create new collections management guidelines, implement new collections management system). Includes n and percent (Yes/No/Total) cells.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technology Primary Focus by Museum Size and Award Amount (Table III-15)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-15: Number and Percent of Projects with Technology as Primary Focus Area by Museum Size and Award Amount
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Breakdown of Technology/Online Resources primary-focus projects by museum size (Small/Medium/Large) and award amount (<$50,000; $50,000-99,000; $100,000 or more). Reports n and percent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digitization/Collections Activities Conducted (Table III-16)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-16: Number and Percent of Projects with Digitization\Collections Activities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows counts and percents of projects that conducted digitization-related activities (e.g., digitize collections, convert non-digital content to digital, repurpose digital content, create new digital content) and whether collections activities (inventory, move, create finding guides, new guidelines, implement system) were conducted. Provides Yes/No/Total with n and %.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digitization/Collections as Primary Focus by Other Activity Areas (Table III-17)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-17: Number and Percent of Projects with Digitization\Collections as the Primary Focus by Other Activity Areas Conducted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-tab of projects with primary focus Digitization/Collections by whether they conducted other program, exhibitions, technology/online resource, or organizational development activities. Includes n and percent (Yes/No/Total).

rubrics_metrics.name: Digitization/Collections Primary Focus by Specific Technical/Online Activities (Table III-18a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-18a: Number and Percent of Projects with Digitization\Collections as the Primary Focus by Other Activities Conducted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subtable listing specific tech/online and content activities (e.g., update/create website; create online access to records; purchase technology equipment; consolidate multiple databases; develop searchable online database; upgrade/purchase/install new software; create audio tour; create online exhibition; develop high-tech interactive exhibition; produce video/CD/product; produce tech application). Reports Yes/No/Total with n and % for each activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digitization/Collections Primary Focus by Staffing, Contracting, Training, and Research Activities (Table III-18b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-18b: Number and Percent of Projects with Digitization\Collections as the Primary Focus by Other Activities Conducted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subtable showing whether projects provided staff/volunteer/docent training; hired full-time or part-time staff; hired consultants; contracted services; trained interpreters/volunteers/docents; created or expanded interpreter/docent/volunteer programs; supported research and evaluation (including surveys); and developed key management plans or museum outreach. Yes/No/Total with n and %.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digitization/Collections Primary Focus by Public Programs and Education Activities (Table III-18c)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-18c: Number and Percent of Projects with Digitization\Collections as the Primary Focus by Other Activities Conducted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subtable listing public programming and education activities (e.g., concerts, film festivals, live performances, broadcasts, demonstrations/workshops, lectures, community discussion groups, education programs at the institution, in-school programs, afterschool programs, curriculum guides, interpretive programs/materials, classes/institutes, training sessions, conferences, internships/mentoring/apprenticeships). Reports Yes/No/Total with n and %.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digitization/Collections Primary Focus by Exhibit-related Activities (Table III-18d)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-18d: Number and Percent of Projects with Digitization\Collections as the Primary Focus by Other Activities Conducted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subtable showing exhibit activities (e.g., upgrade/expand current exhibit including accessibility; develop concept for new exhibit; research new exhibit; plan new exhibit; fabricate new exhibit; create traveling exhibit; produce brochure/product/materials; incorporate interactive piece into an exhibit; import exhibit materials). Yes/No/Total with n and %.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digitization/Collections Primary Focus by Management/Other Activities (Table III-18e)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-18e: Number and Percent of Projects with Digitization\Collections as the Primary Focus by Other Activities Conducted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subtable covering other activities such as developing key management plans, museum outreach activities, and other activities (presentations, publications). Presents Yes/No/Total counts and percents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digitization/Collections Primary Focus by Museum Size and Award Amount (Table III-19)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-19: Number and Percent of Projects with Digitization\Collections as Primary Focus Area by Museum Size and Award Amount
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Breakout of Digitization/Collections primary-focus projects by museum size (Small/Medium/Large) and award amount (<$50,000; $50,000-99,000; $100,000 or more). Shows n and percent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number and Percent of Projects with Organizational Development Activities (Table III-20)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-20: Number and Percent of Projects with Organizational Development Activities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows counts and percents for a set of organizational-development activities (e.g., provide staff/volunteer/docent training including use of new technology/online resources; support research and evaluation including surveys; develop key management plans). Includes totals and percent Yes/No.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational Development Activity: Hire New Staff/Consultants and Contracting (Table III-20 continued)
rubrics_metrics.description: Hire New Staff — full-time/part-time; hire a consultant; contract for services; create/expand interpreter/docent/volunteer program (as part of organizational development activities)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Counts and percents for hiring full-time staff, hiring part-time staff, hiring consultants, contracting services, and creating/expanding interpreter/docent/volunteer programs (Yes/No/Total with n and %).

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational Development as Primary Focus by Other Activity Areas (Table III-21)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-21: Number and Percent of Projects with Organizational Development as the Primary Focus by Other Activity Areas Conducted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-tab of projects with Organizational Development as primary focus by whether they conducted program, exhibitions, digitization, collections, technology/online resources, and other organizational activities. Provides Yes/No/Total counts and percents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational Development Primary Focus by Public Programs and Performance Activities (Table III-22a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-22a: Number and Percent of Projects with Organizational Development as the Primary Focus by Other Activities Conducted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subtable covering concerts, film festivals, live performances, broadcasts, demonstrations/workshops, lectures, community discussion groups, education programs, and in-school programs. Reports Yes/No/Total with n and %.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational Development Primary Focus by Education/Training/Internship Activities (Table III-22b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-22b: Number and Percent of Projects with Organizational Development as the Primary Focus by Other Activities Conducted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subtable including afterschool programs, curriculum guides, interpretive programs/materials, classes/institutes, training sessions, conferences, internships/mentoring/apprenticeships. Yes/No/Total with counts and percents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational Development Primary Focus by Exhibit-related Activities (Table III-22b/22c continuation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-22b/22c: Number and Percent of Projects with Organizational Development as the Primary Focus by Other Activities Conducted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subtables listing exhibit activities (upgrade/expand current exhibit; develop concept for new exhibit; research/plan/fabricate new exhibit; create traveling exhibit; produce brochures/products/materials; incorporate interactive pieces; import exhibit materials) and web/online/technology activities (update/create website; create online access to collections records; purchase technology equipment; consolidate databases; develop searchable databases; upgrade/install software; create audio tours; create online exhibitions). Each activity reported Yes/No/Total with n and %.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational Development Primary Focus by Production of High-tech or Digital Products (Table III-22d)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-22d: Number and Percent of Projects with Organizational Development as the Primary Focus by Other Activities Conducted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes indicators for high-tech interactive exhibitions, producing video/CD/product, producing tech applications, digitizing collections, converting non-digital content to digital, repurposing digital content, creating new digital content, and percent of collection covered by digitization. Yes/No/Total with n and %.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational Development Primary Focus by Collections Management Activities (Table III-22e)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-22e: Number and Percent of Projects with Organizational Development as the Primary Focus by Other Activities Conducted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subtable covering inventory collections, move collections, create public collections finding guides, create new collections management guidelines/procedures, implement new collections management systems. Reports Yes/No/Total with n and percent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational Development Primary Focus by Museum Size and Award Amount (Table III-23)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-23: Number and Percent of Projects with Organizational Development as Primary Focus Area by Museum Size and Award Amount
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Breakdown of Organizational Development primary-focus projects by museum size (Small/Medium/Large) and award amount (<$50,000; $50,000-99,000; $100,000 or more). Provides n and percent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Projects Engaging Partners and Number of Project Partners by Discipline/Size/Award (Table III-24)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-24: Number and Percent of Projects Engaging Partners, Number of Project Partners by Museum Discipline, Museum Size, Award Amount
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates whether projects engaged partners (Yes/No) and distribution of total number of project partners (1-2, 3-4, 5 or more) disaggregated by museum discipline, museum size, and award amount. Reports counts and percents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of Partners Engaged by Discipline, Size, Award (Table III-25)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-25: Number and Percent of Projects Engaging Types of Partners by Museum Discipline, Museum Size, and Award Amount
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows whether projects engaged specific partner types (museum/library partners, government partners, educational partners, community organizations, policy/research organizations, etc.) with Yes/No totals disaggregated by museum discipline, museum size, and award amount. Provides n and %.

rubrics_metrics.name: Projects Partnering with Community Organizations (Table III-26)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-26: Number and Percent of Projects Partnering with Community Organizations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Breakdown (of those partnering) by community organization type: community health facility, family services organization, youth organization, senior services, arts and culture organization, legal services, local media, civic organization, local business, other non-profit, other non-government, non-profit membership groups, environmental/preservation/scientific groups, foundations, individuals (scholars/artists), other (church). Reports n and percent of partnering projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Projects Partnering with Educational Institutions (Table III-27)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-27: Number and Percent of Projects Partnering with Educational Institutions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Of those partnering with educational institutions: counts and percents for partnerships with elementary schools, secondary schools, 4-year colleges, community colleges, other educational organizations, district educational services/associations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Projects Partnering with Government Organizations (Table III-28)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-28: Number and Percent of Projects Partnering with Government Organizations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Of those partnering with government organizations: counts and percents for state government, local government, city government, other government, federal government partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Projects Partnering with Other Museums and Libraries (Table III-29)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-29: Number and Percent of Projects Partnering with Other Museums and Libraries
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Breakdown of partnerships with other museum/library types: history-based museum, science-based museum, art museum, children's/youth museum, general museum collections from two or more disciplines, library, specialized museum collections limited to one discipline. Provides n and percent (of those partnering).

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership Status and Partnership Types by Primary Activity Area (Table III-30)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table III-30: Number and Percent of Partnership Status and Partnership Types by Primary Activity Area
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows partnership prevalence and types by primary activity area (Technology/Online Resources, Organizational Development, Programming, Exhibitions, Digitization/Collections): overall working with partners (Yes/No), total number of partners, number of museum/library partners, number of government partners, number of community organization partners, number of educational partners, number of policy/research organization partners. Includes significance notes where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number and Percent of Projects by Audiences Served by Primary Project Area (Table IV-1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table IV-1: Number and Percent of Projects by Audiences Served by Primary Project Area
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Breaks out audiences served (general audiences, adult learners, seniors, parents, youth, students, families), plus museum staff audiences (paid staff, unpaid staff, administrators), targeted community audiences (residents of particular communities/special interests, persons with disabilities, low-income citizens), specific ethnic communities, professional audiences (professionals, policymakers, not group-specific). Disaggregated by primary activity area. Reports Yes/No/Total counts and percents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary Activity Area by Number of Audience Groups Served (Table IV-2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table IV-2: Primary Activity Area by Number of Audience Groups Served
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each primary activity area, reports count of projects and descriptive statistics for number of audience groups served (mean, median, minimum, maximum).

rubrics_metrics.name: Projects by Primary Project Area and Museum Discipline by Type of Audience Served (Table IV-3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table IV-3: Number and Percent of Projects by Primary Project Area and Museum Discipline by Type of Audience Served
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows whether projects served internal audiences only (museum staff) or external audiences, disaggregated by primary activity area and museum discipline. Provides n and percent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Projects by Age Groups Served by Primary Project Area (Table IV-4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Table IV-4: Number and Percent of Projects by Age Groups Served by Primary Project Area
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports whether projects served adult and family groups (preschool or younger, post-high school/young adults, adults, seniors, multi-age/families) and school-aged children by grade bands (Grades K-5, Grades 6-8, Grades 9-12), disaggregated by primary activity area. Yes/No/Total counts and percents are presented.
